tasks.title: Add the google-oauth feature and register the module
tasks.description: Add google-oauth = [] as an additive default-off feature and register the module behind cfg(feature).

tasks.title: Define the five public types
tasks.description: GoogleOAuthClient, AuthorizationRequest, TokenResponse, TokenStore, RevokeRequest, plus a non-durable MemoryTokenStore. TokenStore must be object-safe.

tasks.title: Build the authorization URL with state and PKCE
tasks.description: Emit response_type=code, scopes, redirect URI, a CSPRNG state, and code_challenge with S256. No code path may omit PKCE.

tasks.title: Exchange the code for tokens
tasks.description: Post code and verifier to the token endpoint; return a typed response with absolute expiry computed from the injected clock.

tasks.title: Refresh once on 401 and persist through the store
tasks.description: At most one refresh per request; save the refreshed record; a second 401 fails without another attempt.

tasks.title: Revoke a token and delete the record
tasks.description: Call the revocation endpoint once and remove the record through the TokenStore.

tasks.title: Map Google errors into WirekitError
tasks.description: Map error and error_description to Auth for credential failures and Api for provider-side failures, preserving the provider code.

tasks.title: Validate untrusted input
tasks.description: Error bodies, redirect parameters, and scope strings produce typed errors; bound the body before decoding; no panic path.

tasks.title: Redact secrets and scope client state
tasks.description: Secret, access token, and refresh token render ***; no Serialize on those types; no global cache; credentials only from construction.

tasks.title: Enforce HTTPS and the endpoint override
tasks.description: Reject a non-HTTPS token endpoint unless it is loopback and explicitly allowed.

tasks.title: Rate-limit the token endpoint
tasks.description: Charge requests to the shared per-provider bucket with a caller override.

tasks.title: Emit tracing without values
tasks.description: Trace authorization, exchange, refresh, revoke, and errors; never record a token, verifier, or secret.

tasks.title: Accept the helper as a google_lsa token source
tasks.description: google_lsa accepts the helper for refresh and still accepts a static token.

tasks.title: Build the documentation
tasks.description: cargo doc --all-features --no-deps passes with RUSTDOCFLAGS=-D warnings.

tasks.title: Compile the feature combinations
tasks.description: Baseline, google-oauth, and google-lsa each compile on Rust 1.85.
